dish.n: Sydney rock oysters with lemon and mignonette
dish.note: Freshly opened oysters with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette.
dish.how: Ask the fishmonger to open 24 Sydney rock oysters on the day, or open them at home with an oyster knife. Stir 3 tbsp red wine vinegar with 1 finely diced shallot and plenty of cracked black pepper. Serve the oysters on crushed ice with the mignonette and lemon wedges.

steps.text: Dice the shallot finely and stir into the vinegar with the pepper.
Cut the lemons into wedges and set the ice on a platter.
Lay the oysters on the ice and serve with the mignonette and lemon.

dish.make_ahead: Buy the oysters the day you serve them; make the mignonette up to 1 day ahead

veg.n: Roasted oyster mushrooms with lemon and mignonette (vegetarian)

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the oil and salt and roast at 220C until golden.
Dice the shallot finely and stir into the vinegar with the pepper.
Pile the mushrooms on a platter with the mignonette and lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mignonette up to 1 day ahead; roast the mushrooms just before serving

dish.vegNote: Roasted oyster mushrooms with the same mignonette
